| Construct | Kind | Purpose | Reach for it when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Comparator` | Class | A single version constraint: a comparison operator applied to a version. Comparator strings accept an optional operator prefix (`=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`) followed by a complete version; a missing operator means `=`. Wildcards and range sugar are not allowed — those belong to `Range`. | |
| `ComparatorSet` | TypeAlias | A comparator set: comparators combined with AND semantics. A version must satisfy every comparator in the set to match. | |
| `Comparator_base` | Variable | | |
| `EmptyCacheError` | Class | Indicates that an extremum (`latest`/`oldest`) was requested from an empty cache. | |
| `EmptyCacheError_base` | Variable | | |
| `InvalidComparatorError` | Class | Indicates that a string could not be parsed as a single comparator. | |
| `InvalidComparatorError_base` | Variable | | |
| `InvalidRangeError` | Class | Indicates that a string could not be parsed as a range expression. | |
| `InvalidRangeError_base` | Variable | | |
| `InvalidVersionError` | Class | Indicates that a string could not be parsed as a valid SemVer 2.0.0 version. | |
| `InvalidVersionError_base` | Variable | | |
| `Range` | Class | A SemVer range expression: a union (OR) of {@link ComparatorSet}s. Supports node-semver syntax — hyphen ranges (`1.0.0 - 2.0.0`), X-ranges (`1.x`, `*`), tilde (`~1.2.3`), caret (`^1.2.3`) and `\|\|` unions — which parsing desugars into primitive comparators and normalizes. | |
| `Range_base` | Variable | | |
| `SemVer` | Class | A parsed SemVer 2.0.0 version: an Effect `Schema.Class` whose fields are validated in-schema (non-negative integer components, well-formed identifiers), so `SemVer.make` only produces valid versions. | |
| `SemVerBump` | Class | Grouped bump operations returned by the {@link SemVer.bump} accessor. Every operation returns a new {@link SemVer}; build metadata never survives a bump. | |
| `SemVer_base` | Variable | | |
| `UnsatisfiableConstraintError` | Class | Indicates that intersecting ranges produced no satisfiable comparator set. | |
| `UnsatisfiableConstraintError_base` | Variable | | |
| `UnsatisfiedRangeError` | Class | Indicates that the cache contains versions but none satisfies the requested range. Carries the range and the versions that were available, and is fully serializable — both payload fields are schema classes. | |
| `UnsatisfiedRangeError_base` | Variable | | |
| `VersionCache` | Class | An in-memory sorted version cache: mutation, query, resolution and navigation over a set of {@link SemVer} versions ordered by SemVer precedence. Pure state (a `Ref` of a sorted array) — no IO. | |
| `VersionCacheShape` | Interface | Operations of the {@link VersionCache} service. | |
| `VersionCache_base` | Variable | | |
| `VersionDiff` | Class | The difference between two {@link SemVer} versions: the classification of the change plus signed numeric deltas. A `Schema.TaggedClass` — the one concept in this package where serialized tag discrimination earns its keep. | |
| `VersionDiff_base` | Variable | | |
| `VersionNotFoundError` | Class | Indicates that a navigation operation (`diff`/`next`/`prev`) referenced a version that is not in the cache. | |
| `VersionNotFoundError_base` | Variable | | |
